svg.text: • Search mode is always hybrid in EduCopilot. Each search returns up to 50 candidates (TOP_K_MAX).
• RRF: score = Σ 1 / (60 + rank) over both rankings, divided by the best possible score (2/61), so scores fall
• The score threshold is ONE setting (SCORE_THRESHOLD_DEFAULT): the code default is 0.5 and the demo launcher
set it to 0.25. They are alternatives, not two filters.
• Verification reduces unsupported answers but does not guarantee correctness: the support check is a coarse
• Generation settings: llama3:latest, temperature 0, at most 512 output tokens, 8,192-token context, JSON
